Base class of the peptide to protein aggregators

Source: R/LFQDataAggregator.R
AggregatorBase.Rd

Base class of the peptide to protein aggregators

Base class of the peptide to protein aggregators

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Holds the fields, construction, and plotting shared by AggregateMedpolish, AggregateRlm, AggregateTopN and AggregateLimpa. Subclasses implement aggregate().

See also

Other LFQData: AggregateLimpa, AggregateMedpolish, AggregateRlm, AggregateTopN, LFQData, LFQDataPlotter, LFQDataStats, LFQDataSummariser, LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment()
